title: Flatten a style prop
summary: Merge nested style arrays the way StyleSheet.flatten does.
prompt: Write `flattenStyle(style)`. A style is an object, a falsy value (`false`, `null`, `undefined`) or an array of styles, nested to any depth. Return one new object: walk arrays left to right, skip falsy entries, and let later keys override earlier ones. Never mutate the inputs. A falsy top-level style returns `{}`. There is no React Native runtime here, so this is modelled as plain TypeScript.
hints: Recurse into arrays and `Object.assign` objects onto one result.
Start from a fresh `{}` so inputs are not mutated.
